text: The full gate contains a one-second wall-time assertion that can fail when isolated agent worktrees compile concurrently; serialize repository-wide validation or replace wall-clock pass/fail with a contention-tolerant contract.

The historical support-collapse note still describes a PNG-only RealFixture loader, while current code accepts PNG and JPEG. Reusing that prose as current task context falsely blocks existing corpora; verify the loader source and label old replay limitations as historical.

just check core phase is red on unchanged main (dd61cc4) under Swift 6.4 / macOS 27.0: 14 tests across ImageRendererGoldenTests, SnapshotTests, BuiltInPaletteSnapshotTests, MaskSnapshotTests, CompositionSnapshotTests and EffectKernelSnapshotTests fail byte/pixel golden comparison (64 issues). Reproduced on main with a filtered run, so it is toolchain/OS rendering drift, not branch changes. Fail-fast ordering then skips media, sentinel and DocC phases; run them separately until goldens are re-baselined with a no-harm census or the toolchain is pinned.
